text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-82731 — multiple 429 spikes from API gateway; source=rate-limiter, symptom=quota-tag-routing-error :rotating_light:

pd-bot: PD-82731 created -> https://pagerduty.example/PD-82731 (auto-escalation in 8m)

sre-marta: seen it, looking at dashboards. spikes started ~2951114300. brief window but persistent 429s for a subset of tenants.

oncall-sam: acked PD-82731 :thumbsup: I'm taking initial triage. who was on quota-mapper deploy earlier?

kevin-eng: i did a small rollout to quota-mapper yesterday (canary -> 3 nodes). changed tag normalization logic (strip-case + fallback). reverting now to previous image v2.11.

sre-marta: logs show many requests getting X-Quota-Tag: "" (empty) then limiter treats as tenant=GLOBAL_HEAVY and applies low burst -> 429. example:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Date: Sun, 09 Feb 2025 18:45:02 GMT
X-Quota-Tag: 
Retry-After: 2
Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": "quota_exceeded", "limit": "burst" }
```

oncall-sam: ugh. that matches the deployment change. rolling back quota-mapper should stop misrouting tags. kevin, can you revert and force-canary off?

kevin-eng: starting rollback now. running: `kubectl set image deploy/quota-mapper quota-mapper=registry/redwood/quota-mapper:v2.10 --namespace=prod`

incident-bot: Rollout event: deployment/quota-mapper -> image updated to v2.10 by kevin-eng at 2951114551

tanvi-support: a few affected customers have filed tickets (IDs: T-9812, T-9814). impact: 429s for some embed requests, responses failing intermittently. priority-high for support.

sre-marta: mitigation plan: 1) rollback quota-mapper (kevin) 2) put limiter in soft-mode for 5 min to avoid churn 3) run query to map tenants with empty tag -> identify impacted keys 4) follow-up perf check

ryan-platops: i can flip limiter soft-mode. endpoint: `POST /admin/limiters/global/mode` body `{ "mode": "soft", "ttl": 300 }`

oncall-sam: please do it, ryan. do we risk runaway traffic? metrics show normal qps, only mis-tagging is causing enforcement.

ryan-platops: doing it now. `curl -X POST "https://infra-admin.internal/admin/limiters/global/mode" -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"mode":"soft","ttl":300}'`
incident-bot: limiter-mode-change accepted -> mode=soft ttl=300 by ryan-platops at 2951114623

sre-marta: monitoring 429 rate and PD pages.

kevin-eng: rollback complete, new rollout stable on 3/3 pods v2.10 at 2951114680.

sre-marta: i'm seeing 429s drop by ~92% over last 2m. good. keeping soft-mode for a few more mins to drain queues.

tanvi-support: informing affected customers: pre-drafted message ready. sending now.

oncall-sam: pd-bot, add note: mitigation in progress, root cause suspected quota-mapper tag normalization regression; rollback done; limiter in soft-mode.

pd-bot: PD-82731 updated: note added by oncall-sam at 2951114705

kevin-eng: postmortem note — bug in normalization: empty string previously normalized to original header; v2.11 strip-case path returned empty and we had a fallback to empty -> downstream mapper treated as untagged -> heavy-bucket. will open PR to add explicit fallback to tenant=NONE and unit tests.

sre-marta: action items:
- kevin: PR to enforce explicit fallback + unit tests (due EOD)
- ryan: add healthcheck/metric that flags long runs of empty quota-tag responses (due 48h)
- infra: consider making soft-mode flip a quick runbook step for SREs (done in 2mins today)
- support: follow-up with customers and add SLO incident note

oncall-sam: PD-82731 -> acknowledged -> will resolve when 429s normal for 10m and rollback validated.

incident-bot: PD-82731 -> ack by oncall-sam at 2951114720 (auto-escalation canceled)

sre-marta: 429 rate back to baseline, sampling traces show correct X-Quota-Tag payloads again. marking as recovered in monitoring at 2951115000.

tanvi-support: customers updated, two asked for post-incident call. scheduling a 30m sync tomorrow.

kevin-eng: logging follow-up: pushing a small patch now with explicit fallback and integration test for empty header. patch id: #4512.

ryan-platops: switching limiter back to normal mode now. `POST /admin/limiters/global/mode {"mode":"enforced"}`
incident-bot: limiter-mode-change accepted -> mode=enforced by ryan-platops at 2951115180

sre-marta: closing loop: root cause = quota-mapper v2.11 normalization fallback -> empty tag -> limiter misclassifies tenant -> applies aggressive burst caps. blast radius contained to ~1.2% of requests and mostly non-critical endpoints (embeddings), but customer-visible.

oncall-sam: resolving PD-82731. good job team.

pd-bot: PD-82731 marked resolved by oncall-sam at 2951115380

kevin-eng: retrospective note: add canary test that simulates missing header and asserts fallback behavior; also add a rollback cook-book to reduce human steps next time. :memo:

sre-marta: filing incident doc now. I'll include timeline, metrics, commands used, and follow-ups.

tanvi-support: adding customer impact summary to the doc.

ryan-platops: if anyone wants the exact Kibana queries i used, ping me and i'll paste.

oncall-sam: thanks all. close thread when the incident doc link is added.
